review_history.finding: The initial execution-wave map correctly warned that branch existence is not activity evidence, but individual rows did not encode activity state. A reader could therefore still misread closed or merely observed branch heads as current active execution and branch count as progress.
review_history.substantive_remediation: Added activity_state and activity_evidence to every wave row and explicitly distinguished active GOV06 work, closed qualified heads, unresolved lanes, current authority snapshots and closed B4/production.

counter_hypothesis.alternative: Do not create GOV06 because existing ANIMO RG, GOV03-GOV05 and migration documents already provide enough governance, and importing SWAP-style regie risks duplicate authority and scope gaming.
counter_hypothesis.test: Check whether GOV06 replaces scientific, routing, queue, aggregate or architecture authorities, or instead supplies missing cross-cutting ownership/resumption/module/scope contracts while pinning existing authorities as sources of truth.
counter_hypothesis.result: GOV06 is defensible only as a governance overlay. It explicitly forbids automatic authority promotion, keeps the module registry non-normative for scientific semantics, leaves B3Q06 negative, leaves B4 closed, and sets the whole-program denominator to DENOMINATOR_NOT_YET_QUALIFIED.

challenge_notes.swap_assumption_transfer: Only abstract ownership, resumption, maturity, denominator-discipline and module-governance lessons were transferred. SWAP weights, topology, solver contracts, naming and completion percentages were rejected.
challenge_notes.scope_gaming: No numerical denominator or percentage is created. The capability map keeps B3, architecture, B4, testbank, documentation, Status A, Status AA and optional research distinct.
challenge_notes.branch_count_as_progress: Remediation makes activity evidence explicit and prohibits treating observed closed branches as active work or progress.
challenge_notes.tcd_count_as_program_completion: The policy explicitly rejects TCD counts as whole-program completion and preserves B3Q06 as a scientific-composition gate only.
challenge_notes.research_as_production: Four maturity states are explicit and no transition is automatic; optional research has no production-completion weight by default.
challenge_notes.evidence_as_authority: B0/B1/B2/B3, synthetic/reconstructed, model-evolution and production authority remain separate; evidence cannot self-promote.
challenge_notes.child_to_parent_promotion: Child admission is explicitly non-equivalent to parent admission and aggregate composition is serialized.
challenge_notes.same_agent_as_independent: Review is labeled PROCESS_SELF_REVIEWED_NOT_INDEPENDENT and GOV05 lower-independence assurance is preserved.
challenge_notes.runtime_interruption_as_invalidity: Durable resumption records and retained semantic ownership distinguish runtime interruption from scientific invalidity.
challenge_notes.parallel_moving_contract_coownership: SAFE_PARALLEL requires no shared moving semantic contract; shared program authority and same moving semantics serialize regardless of branch/file separation.
challenge_notes.module_registry_second_truth: Registry is explicitly an index/governance overlay and points to governing authorities rather than restating equations or scientific semantics.
challenge_notes.retroactive_science_invalidation: Policy states existing qualified B3 science is not invalidated retroactively; schema conformance applies prospectively to new or materially changed modules before B4.

residual_uncertainty: This is same-agent adversarial review and therefore does not provide genuine independence.
The initial module registry is deliberately coarse. Scientific responsibility boundaries still require authority-backed manifests before material module change or B4 admission.
TCD-034 ownership was not reconstructed by GOV06 and remains an explicit live-recheck requirement rather than an inferred owner.
The whole-program completion denominator remains unqualified; future scope freezing may change the capability map through a new versioned governance authority.
